title: Combined Hero-cum-Sati Stone
detailed_description: Bi-panelled hero-cum-sati stone commemorating a hero who died a heroic death and his faithful wife who followed him to the pyre (funeral fire). The lowermost panel represents the faithful wife standing with folded hands before her husband's pyre. Ready to self immolate; she is flanked be devotees. Musicians are depicted within a structural frame just below the sati; they are playing drum and gong. The upper panel illustrates the enthroned hero in heaven seated on a high throne and his wife on a lower throne to his left side. The heroic couple are shown as attended and worshipped by apsaras and devotees. The roof topping of the slab has a kalasha on its apex which is slightly damaged.
